name: Sorted: Left to spend
subtitle: Bills, plans, a clearer view
promotionalText: See your estimated left to spend, upcoming payments and the accounts that need attention. Review plans and Penny's proposed changes, with the choice staying yours.
shortDescription: See estimated left to spend, upcoming bills and plans in one calmer money view.
description:
A clearer view of your money until payday.

Sorted brings your money into a calmer view, with figures you can inspect and choices that stay yours.

SEE WHAT IS LEFT UNTIL PAYDAY
See an estimated left to spend after upcoming bills, plans and your buffer. Open the calculation to understand the working. Estimates depend on the bank data and information available, and can miss unconnected accounts, late payments or bills Sorted has not spotted.

CHECK WHAT IS COMING
View expected payments and an account-by-account forecast. An overall balance can hide a gap in the account a payment leaves from. Payments can take a day or two to appear.

REVIEW YOUR NEXT STEP
Inspect move suggestions and the accounts considered for cover. Review a payday plan and your longer-term plans. Sorted does not make the bank transfer.

KEEP INVESTMENTS IN VIEW
Track recorded investment balances alongside your wider money picture. Capital at risk. Tracking is not investment advice.

ASK PENNY
Talk through a money question and review supported changes Penny proposes. Confirm a proposal only if it is right for you. Ongoing permissions have a separate consent step. General information, not regulated financial advice.

CONNECT YOUR BANKS
Choose your bank, review the connection information and continue to Finexer. Open banking is provided by Finexer Ltd, with AURIQ LTD acting as its agent. Availability depends on your bank and account.

Example images use fictional data. Forecasts and suggestions are estimates, not guarantees.
